title: Profile
notConnectedYet: Profile activates once the backend is connected.

error.title: Could not load profile
error.description: Something went wrong while fetching your profile. Please try again.

empty.title: No profile yet
empty.description: Create your profile to complete your details. You can edit it anytime.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.subtitle: Demo data: nothing is sent to a server; it stays in memory until Supabase is wired.

avatar.permissionDenied: Photo library permission was not granted.
avatar.tooLarge: The image is too large (8 MB max).
avatar.processingFailed: Image processing failed, so nothing was uploaded — for your privacy.
avatar.failed: Could not upload the photo. Please try again.
avatar.sessionNote: The photo is center-cropped and re-encoded to drop EXIF. Its URL lives in this session only until P18.

validation.displayNameMin: Name is too short (at least 2 characters).
validation.displayNameMax: Name is too long (60 characters max).
validation.chain: The location chain is incomplete. Pick a governorate, then a district.

locations.pending: Location data is demo data awaiting human verification before real use.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account and app preferences. Some items activate in the third part of P06.
settings.serverNote: Server persistence activates in P18. Local preferences are stored on your device.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Your session ends and sensitive local data is cleared.

appearance.note: Dark is the platform's approved identity.
appearance.unavailable: Light and system modes are not available yet; no approved light palette exists.

numbers.note: Affects screens that use the number formatter.

notifications.noPushYet: No real notifications are sent until P16. These preferences are saved now and used later.

privacy.visibilityTitle: Who can see your display name
privacy.visibilityNote: There are no public individual profiles. This is enforced server-side in P18.
privacy.storiesNote: An optional consent you can withdraw anytime; it never affects your eligibility.
privacy.noConsents: No consents recorded on this account.
privacy.withdrawNote: Withdrawing essential consents (terms/privacy) means closing the account, available via account deletion in P06.3.

what.a: A non-profit platform for easier marriage through disciplined assistance, group weddings, partners and Souk Khair.

privacy.q: Is my data visible to others?
privacy.a: No. There are no public profiles; beneficiary data is restricted to authorized roles on a minimum basis.

assistance.a: Requests are submitted in the Assistance section and reviewed by a human. Automated scoring is advisory only.

about.principles: Non-profit, no dating services, spouse choice belongs to families, and no assistance without human verification.
